blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Evaluating semantic similarity between videos is a fundamental challenge in computer vision, essential for tasks ranging from out-of-distribution (OOD) detection to video retrieval. However, defining and labeling video similarity is notoriously difficult and expensive due to the complex spatio-temporal nature. In this paper, we propose a novel self-supervised approach that leverages generative uncertainty from text-to-video (T2V) diffusion models to learn semantic similarity without human annotations. Our method is based on the observation that T2V models produce consistent outputs for familiar concepts but exhibit high variance and uncertainty when prompted with specialized concepts. We utilize this behavior to identify stable semantic features within existing pretrained representations, such as VideoMAE and V-JEPA. Specifically, we learn a mask over these embeddings using purely generated data, encouraging the model to retain features that remain consistent across generations of general concepts while discarding those associated with generative noise or uncertainty. Experimental results across three key tasks demonstrate that our learned feature subspaces consistently outperform original pretrained features and baseline feature selection methods.
blocks.zh: 评估视频之间的语义相似性是计算机视觉中的一个基本挑战,对于从发布外(OOD)检测到视频检索等一系列任务至关重要. 然而,由于复杂的时空性质,对视频的相似性进行定义和标签是众所周知的困难和昂贵的。 在本文中,我们提出了一种新的自我监督的方法,利用文本到视频(T2V)传播模型的基因不确定性,在没有人类说明的情况下学习语义相似性. 我们的方法是基于一种看法,即T2V模型为熟悉的概念产生一致的输出,但在有专门的概念时却表现出高度的差异和不确定性。 我们利用这一行为,在诸如VideoMAE和V-JEPA等现有预先训练过的表述中,找出稳定的语义特征. 具体地说,我们利用纯粹生成的数据,在这些嵌入物上学习了一个面具,鼓励该模型保留各代人之间仍然一致的一般概念的特征,同时抛弃那些与遗传噪音或不确定性有关的特征。 三项关键任务的实验结果表明,我们所学到的特征子空间的性能始终高于原先预先训练的特征和基线特征选择方法。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Learning semantic similarity between videos is important for many tasks, such as out-of-distribution (OOD) detection ( Sim et al., 2023 ) , video retrieval ( Dwibedi et al., 2019 ) , and evaluating generative models ( Liu et al., 2024 ) . Yet, learning such similarity from human annotations is challenging: videos contain rich spatio-temporal information, and judging which aspects are semantically relevant is inherently difficult ( Zhang et al., 2018 ) . Collecting similarity annotations at scale is therefore expensive and often infeasible, particularly for open-domain or generated videos.
This motivates the question: how can we learn video representations that capture semantic similarity without using labeled data?
blocks.zh:
视频之间的语义学相似性对于许多任务都很重要,比如外传(OO)检测(Sim等人,2023年),视频检索(Dwibedi等人,2019年),以及基因模型评价(Liu等人,2024年). 然而,从人类说明中学习这种相似性具有挑战性:视频包含丰富的时空信息,判断哪些方面在本质上是相关的(Zhang等人,2018年)。 因此,大规模收集相似性说明费用昂贵,而且往往不可行,对于开放领域或制作的视频尤其如此。
这引发了这样一个问题:我们如何可以学习不使用标注数据而捕捉语义相似性的视频表达?

blocks.en: Self-supervised video models such as VideoMAEv2 ( Wang et al., 2023 ) and VJEPA 2.1 ( Mur-Labadia et al., 2026 ) provide strong general-purpose representations across many downstream tasks. However, their training objectives are not designed explicitly for measuring semantic similarity, and their feature spaces can contain dimensions that are irrelevant or even detrimental to similarity-based tasks. As we show experimentally, directly comparing these representations can lead to limited alignment with human judgments and unreliable uncertainty estimates for generated videos.
blocks.zh: VideoMAEv2(Wang等人,2023年)和VJEPA 2.1(Mur-Labadia等人,2026年)等自我监督的视频模型为许多下游任务提供了强大的通用表现. 然而,其培训目标并非明确用于测量语义相似性,其特征空间可能包含与基于相似性的任务无关甚至有害的维度. 正如我们实验性地展示的那样,直接比较这些表述会导致与人类判断的配合有限,并且生成的视频的不确定性估计不可靠.

blocks.en:
We investigate whether pretrained video representations can instead be adapted for semantic similarity using only synthetic data from text-to-video (T2V) models. Our key observation is that the diversity of a generative model’s outputs provides a natural self-supervised signal.
When a model is given a prompt describing a general concept, it generates videos that tend to be consistent with each other. In contrast, when the prompt describes a specialized concept to the model, the generated videos are more diverse and less consistent (Fig. 2 ).
We refer to this diversity as generative uncertainty and use it to identify which feature dimensions are most useful for measuring semantic similarity.
blocks.zh:
我们调查的是,预先训练过的视频表达方式是否可以仅利用文本到视频(T2V)模型的合成数据来适应语义相似性。 我们的主要观察是,基因模型产出的多样性提供了一个自然的自我监督的信号。
当给一个模型一个描述一般概念的提示时,它生成的视频往往相互一致. 相比之下,当提示向模型描述一个专门的概念时,生成的视频更加多样,且不一致(图2).
我们把这种多样性称为基因不确定性,并利用它来确定哪些特征维度最有助于测量语义相似性。

blocks.en:
To achieve this, we rely entirely on synthetic data generated by a T2V model. We generate videos from two types of prompts: (i) general concepts that the model can generate reliably, and (ii) specialized concepts (i.e., concepts belonging to highly specific or niche domains) that lead to more uncertain, and therefore diverse outputs.
Particularly, our method does not require generative variability to be a perfect measure of whether a concept was seen during training.
Our hypothesis is weaker: if some representation dimensions remain stable when repeated generations preserve the same semantic content, but become variable when the generated content becomes less consistent, then this difference in variability can reveal dimensions that are useful for semantic similarity.
For each prompt, we generate multiple videos, varying only the initial noise, and learn a mask over pretrained video embeddings, encouraging embeddings of videos generated from the same general prompt to be more similar than videos generated from the same specialized prompt. Importantly,
all pairs are therefore obtained from videos generated with the same prompt, avoiding human similarity annotations or predefined semantic relations between prompts.
blocks.zh:
为了实现这一目标,我们完全依靠T2V模型生成的合成数据. 我们从两类提示产生视频:(一) 模型可以可靠生成的一般概念,(二) 专业概念(即属于高度具体或特殊领域的概念),这些概念导致更不确定,因而产出也多种多样。
尤其是,我们的方法并不要求基因变化是衡量培训期间是否看到一个概念的完美尺度。
我们的假设比较弱:如果一些表示维度在反复代保存相同的语义内容时保持稳定,但在生成的内容变得不太一致时变得可变,那么这种变异性的差异可以揭示出对语义相似性有用的维度.
对于每个提示,我们生成多个视频,只改变最初的噪音,在预先训练的视频嵌入器上学习一个面具,鼓励嵌入来自同一一般提示的视频比来自同一专业提示的视频更相似. 重要的是,
因此,所有对子都是从同一即时生成的视频中获取的,避免了人类相似性说明或预定义的提示之间的语义关系.

blocks.en:
We find that the learned feature subspaces consistently outperform the original features and other subspace methods using different T2V models and across three similarity-based tasks: human alignment, OOD detection for generated samples, and video retrieval.
At the same time, the learned masks retain only a fraction of the original feature dimensions, yielding more compact representations. We further evaluate patch-level masking for video object segmentation and observe minimal performance loss despite substantial dimensionality reduction (Appendix C.5 ).
blocks.zh:
我们发现,所学的特征子空间使用不同的T2V模型,并跨越基于相似性的三项任务,即人类对齐,生成样本的OOD检测,以及视频检索,始终比原始特征和其他子空间方法表现得更好.
同时,学得的口罩只保留了原始特征维度的一小部分,产生了更紧凑的表示. 我们进一步评价用于视频物体分割的补丁层遮罩,并观察到尽管大幅减小尺寸但性能损失最小(附录C.5 )。

blocks.en: Overall, our main contributions are as follows: • We identify generative uncertainty in T2V models as a self-supervised signal for semantic similarity: general concepts produce relatively consistent generations, whereas specialized concepts yield more diverse outputs. • Using this signal, we introduce a lightweight, model-agnostic method that learns sparse subspaces of pretrained video representations and improves human-similarity alignment, OOD detection, and video retrieval across different feature encoders.
blocks.zh: 总的来说,我们的主要贡献如下: 我们把T2V模型中的基因不确定性确定为语义相似性的自我监督信号:一般概念产生相对一致的代数,而专业概念产生更多样化的输出. ——利用这个信号,我们引入了一种轻量级,模型-不可知性的方法,该方法学习了经过预先训练的视频表现的稀疏的子空间,并改进了不同功能编码器的人类-同源性对接,OOD检测和视频检索.

blocks.en: We identify generative uncertainty in T2V models as a self-supervised signal for semantic similarity: general concepts produce relatively consistent generations, whereas specialized concepts yield more diverse outputs.
blocks.zh: 我们把T2V模型中的基因不确定性确定为语义相似性的自我监督信号:一般概念产生相对一致的代数,而专业概念产生更多样化的输出.

blocks.en: Using this signal, we introduce a lightweight, model-agnostic method that learns sparse subspaces of pretrained video representations and improves human-similarity alignment, OOD detection, and video retrieval across different feature encoders.
blocks.zh: 利用这个信号,我们引入了一种轻量级的模型不可知性方法,该方法学习了经过预先训练的视频表现的稀疏的子空间,并改进了不同功能编码器之间的人-同质性对接,OOD检测和视频检索.

blocks.en: 2 Related work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Defining and quantifying perceptual similarity is a fundamental challenge in computer vision. For static images, deep feature distances have proven very effective ( Zhang et al., 2018 ) due to their close alignment with human perception. However, extending this paradigm to videos is inherently more complex, as recently shown by ConViS-Bench ( Liberatori et al., 2025 ) . Their benchmark shows that recent powerful models for video understanding, such as V-JEPA 2.1 ( Mur-Labadia et al., 2026 ) and VideoMAE V2 ( Wang et al., 2023 ) , extract representations that align only partially with human judgment. In this work, we build upon these backbones, demonstrating that their raw embeddings can be refined into concentrated subspaces via our targeted masking approach to improve performance in video-similarity-based tasks.
blocks.zh: 界定和量化观念上的相似性是计算机视觉中的一个根本挑战。 对于静态图像,由于与人类感知的紧密结合,深度特征距离被证明非常有效(张等人,2018年). 然而,将这个范式推广到视频本身就更为复杂,正如ConViS-Bench(Liberatori等人,2025年)最近所显示的那样. 他们的基准显示,近期的V-JEPA 2.1(Mur-Labadia et al., 2026)和VideoMAE V2(Wang et al., 2023)等视频理解的强大模式,提取的表述只部分符合人类判断. 在这项工作中,我们以这些骨干为基础,表明它们的原始嵌入可以通过我们有针对性的遮掩方法被精炼成集中的子空间,以改善基于视频的同源性任务的表现.

blocks.en:
Video similarity learning itself is most commonly explored through the proxy tasks of video retrieval and near-duplicate detection. This is done, for instance, by temporal context aggregation via contrastive learning ( Shao et al., 2021 ) , temporal alignment for partial video copy detection ( Han et al., 2021 ) , and leveraging region attention graphs ( Ng et al., 2022 ) . Other works propose unified frameworks for event retrieval and recounting ( Gao et al., 2017 ) , suppress irrelevant frames to improve video-to-video retrieval ( Jo et al., 2024 ) , or focus explicitly on near-duplicate video retrieval ( He et al., 2022 ) . Other works have explored fully self-supervised methods to learn video similarity directly from visual streams ( Kordopatis-Zilos et al., 2023 ) . He et al. (2022) learns near-duplicate retrieval from massive pools of unlabeled videos, while Kordopatis-Zilos et al. (2023) relies on synthetic proxy tasks created via heavy data augmentations to learn self-supervised similarity.
However, while these methods are effective for retrieval, they often rely on access to large video datasets.
blocks.zh:
视频相似性学习本身最常通过视频检索和近重复检测的代理任务来探索. 例如,通过对比性学习(Shao等人,2021年)进行时间背景汇总,对部分视频副本进行时间调整检测(Han等人,2021年),以及利用区域关注图(Ng等人,2022年)。 其他作品提出事件检索和重新计票的统一框架(Gao等人,2017年),压制不相关的帧来改进视频到视频检索(Jo等人,2024年),或明确注重近似重复的视频检索(He等人,2022年). 其他作品探索了完全自我监督的方法,直接从视觉流中学习视频相似性(Kordopatis-Zilos等人,2023年). 他等人(2022年)从大量无标签的视频库中学习近似重复检索,而Kordopatis-Zilos等人(2023年)则依靠通过重数据增强而创造的合成代用任务来学习自我监督的相似性.
然而,虽然这些方法对于检索是有效的,但它们往往依赖于大型视频数据集的存取.

blocks.en:
One promising avenue, therefore, is to turn to synthetic data. This is largely unexplored in video similarity, although it has seen significant success in other vision domains, such as perceptual image tasks ( Wu et al., 2023 ) or action recognition ( Varol et al., 2021 ) .
In our work, we use synthetic data to bypass the need for real-world video collections or manual augmentations by using the zero-shot outputs of modern text-to-video models to learn video similarity.
blocks.zh:
因此,一个有希望的途径是转向合成数据。 这在视频相似性中基本上没有被探讨,尽管它在其他视觉领域,如感知图像任务(Wu等人,2023年)或动作识别(Varol等人,2021年)中都看到了显著的成功.
在我们的作品中,我们利用合成数据来绕过现实世界视频收藏或人工增强的需要,利用现代文本到视频模型的零镜头输出来学习视频相似性.

blocks.en:
Generative uncertainty. Previous works on generative uncertainty largely focus on developing methods to measure the uncertainty of samples produced by the model. For image generation, this is typically done by adapting the original model into a sort of ensemble by introducing randomness and measuring the distance between generations.
For instance, Berry et al. (2024) obtains multiple fine-tuned versions of the label embedding layer and uses the distances between predicted Gaussians to measure uncertainty, while Jazbec et al. (2025) draws multiple parameter sets from a Laplace approximation of the final layer and uses the CLIP embedding space to measure distances. Other works make use of the inherent randomness in the diffusion denoising process to obtain uncertainty estimates ( De Vita and Belagiannis, 2025 ) .
In scenarios where text is available, such as a prompt for text-to-image methods, vision-language models can be used to assess similarity to the prompt and measure uncertainty ( Franchi et al., 2025 ) .
In this work, we do not propose a new method for measuring generative uncertainty. Rather, to our knowledge, we are the first to exploit this inherent characteristic of generative models to define a self-supervised objective to learn a notion of similarity.
blocks.zh:
遗传不确定性。 以往关于遗传不确定性的著作主要侧重于制定方法,以衡量模型生产的样品的不确定性。 对于图像生成来说,这一般是通过引入随机性,测量世代之间的距离,将原始模型改造为某种综艺.
例如,Berry et al. (2024年)获得标签嵌入层的多个微调版本,并利用预测的高斯人之间的距离来测量不确定性,而Jazbec等人(2025年)则从最后层的拉普拉斯近似度中抽取多个参数集,并使用CLIP嵌入空间来测量距离. 其他作品利用扩散去诺化过程中固有的随机性来获得不确定性估计(De Vita and Belagiannis, 2025.).
在有文本的假想中,如快速文本到图像方法,可使用视觉语言模型评估与快速和计量不确定性的相似性(Franchi等人,2025年)。
在这项工作中,我们没有提出衡量遗传不确定性的新方法。 相反,据我们所知,我们首先要利用基因模型的这一固有特征,确定自我监督的目标,以学习相似性的概念。

blocks.en: 3 Method
blocks.zh: 3 方法

blocks.en: Our method, summarized in Figure 1 , is driven solely by synthetic data, comprising both the generated videos and their source prompts. Human involvement is limited strictly to the initial domain assumptions and prompt curation, which serves as the foundation for our dataset.
blocks.zh: 我们的方法总结于图1, 完全由合成数据驱动, 包括生成的视频及其源提示。 人类的参与严格限于初始域假设和即时整理,这是我们数据集的基础。

blocks.en: Figure 1: Proposed framework overview. (1) A text-to-video model generates videos from general and specialized prompts with different random seeds; videos from the same prompt are paired. (2) A frozen video encoder extracts global representations, and a learnable mask is trained to yield high/low cosine similarity for similar/dissimilar pairs. (3) For downstream tasks, we mask unseen video representations before cosine similarity. In doing so, our strategy improves alignment with human judgment, out-of-distribution detection, and video retrieval.
blocks.zh: 图 1:拟议框架概览。 (1)文本到视频模型生成来自一般和专门提示的视频,有不同的随机种子;来自同一提示的视频成对. (2)冷冻视频编码器提取全局表示,可学习的口罩经过训练,可以产生类似/异构对的高/低余弦相似度. (3)对于下游任务,我们先掩盖看不见的视频表现,再掩盖余弦相似性. 在这样做时,我们的战略改进了与人类判断、分配外探测和视频检索的一致性。

blocks.en: 3.1 Synthetic dataset generation
blocks.zh: 3.1 合成数据集生成

blocks.en:
Defining general concepts. We construct our synthetic dataset using the Wan2.1 (T2V-1.3B) text-to-video model ( Wan et al., 2025 ) . A key challenge lies in partitioning the prompt space into general and specialized concepts relative to the model’s underlying training distribution. While the exact training corpus of Wan2.1 is proprietary, it is documented to include broad domains such as natural landscapes, daily human activities, and general scenery. Furthermore, Wan2.1 demonstrates state-of-the-art performance on the VBench benchmark ( Huang et al., 2024 ) , which evaluates video generation across a wide array of common semantic categories.
Consequently, we define our general set by sampling N = 100 N=100 prompts directly from VBench, representing concepts the model can synthesize with high fidelity and consistency.
blocks.zh:
界定一般概念。 我们使用Wan2.1(T2V-1.3B)文本到视频模型(Wan等人,2025年)构建了我们的合成数据集。 一个关键的挑战在于将迅速的空间分成一般的和专门的概念,与模型的基本培训分布相对。 虽然Wan2.1的确切培训内容是专有的,但据记载,它包括了自然景观、日常人类活动和一般景观等广泛领域。 此外,Wan2.1还展示了在V Bench基准(Huang等人,2024年)上的最新业绩,该基准评价了各种常见语义类的视频生成。
因此,我们通过取样N=100 N=100 直接来自V Bench的提示来定义我们的一般组合,代表着模型能够以高度忠诚和一致性的方式合成的概念。

blocks.en:
Constructing specialized concepts. Conversely, we define specialized prompts as those belonging to highly uncommon or niche domains, such as medical surgery or microscopy, for which current T2V models tend to produce more variable generations in our
experiments (Fig. 3 ). To construct this set, we leveraged Google’s Gemini 3.1 Pro to generate N = 100 N=100 unique prompts from these specialized domains.
To ensure that our downstream evaluation captures semantic domain shifts rather than superficial linguistic variances, we constrained the language model to match the general prompts in terms of length, syntactic complexity, and descriptive granularity. More details in Appendix B.1 .
blocks.zh:
构建专业概念. 相反,我们把专用提示定义为属于非常不寻常或特殊领域的提示,如医疗手术或显微镜,为此,目前的T2V模型往往产生更多的可变代。
实验(图3). 为了构建此集, 我们利用Google的双子座3.1 Pro, 从这些专业领域生成 N = 100 N = 100 的独特提示。
为了确保我们的下游评价能够捕捉语义域变化而不是表面语言差异,我们限制语言模型在长度、综合复杂性和描述性颗粒性方面与一般提示相匹配。 详见附录B.1。

blocks.en:
Generating the synthetic video dataset. For each of the 200 total prompts, we synthesized three distinct videos by varying the initial random seed. This process yielded a dataset of 600 videos. In our framework, videos generated from general prompts serve as proxies for semantic consistency (high intra-prompt similarity), while those from specialized prompts provide a signal for generative divergence, allowing us to learn a similarity subspace without human supervision. Examples of these synthesized general and specialized concepts are presented in Figure 2 while Figure 3 quantitatively shows how general prompts lead to closer embeddings in the chosen feature space.
In Appendix C.1 we present similar findings for other generative models: CogVideoX1.5-5B and Mochi 1.
blocks.zh:
生成合成视频数据集. 对于200个总提示中的每一个,我们通过改变初始随机种子来合成三个不同的视频. 这个过程产生了600个视频的数据集. 在我们的框架中,一般提示产生的视频是语义一致性(高度瞬间相似性)的代名词,而专业提示产生的视频则为基因差异提供了信号,使我们能够在没有人类监督的情况下学习一个相似性子空间. 这些综合的一般和专门概念的例子在图2中列出,而图3在数量上显示一般提示如何导致在选定的特征空间中更紧密地嵌入.
在附录C.1中,我们提出了其他基因模型的类似结论: CogVideoX1.5-5B和莫奇一号机车.

blocks.en: Figure 2: Example videos used in our generative consistency objective. Videos generated by Wan 2.1 with general and specialized text prompts. Videos from general prompts serve as proxies for semantic consistency, while those from specialized prompts represent generative divergence.
blocks.zh: 图 2: 我们基因一致性目标中使用的视频实例。 Wan 2.1生成的视频带有一般和专用的文本提示. 来自一般提示的视频是语义一致性的代词,而来自专门提示的视频代表基因差异。

blocks.en: 3.2 Feature learning via generative consistency
blocks.zh: 3.2 通过基因一致性进行特征学习

blocks.en: Extracting global video features. For a given video v v , we utilize a pretrained ViT-based encoder ℰ \mathcal{E} to extract spatio-temporal features. While these architectures produce a sequence of patch tokens of shape [ P , D ] [P,D] , where P P denotes the number of tokens and D D the embedding dimension, our objective is to capture global semantic similarity rather than localized cues. Thus, we aggregate tokens into a single global representation 𝐳 = ℰ ⁡ ( v ) ∈ ℝ D \mathbf{z}=\mathcal{E}(v)\in\mathbb{R}^{D} via global average pooling across the token dimension.

blocks.en: We verify the effectiveness of our masked features on three similarity-driven tasks using V-JEPA 2.1 and VideoMAEv2 backbones. We additionally provide a theoretical interpretation of our method in Appendix A .

blocks.en: 4.1 Alignment with human perception
blocks.zh: 4.1 与人类观念保持一致

blocks.en:
To validate that our learned feature masks select a subspace in which similarity aligns with human judgment, we evaluate our approach on ConViS-Bench ( Liberatori et al., 2025 ) .
This benchmark proposes a dataset of video pairs meant to measure concept-based video similarity.
Each video pair is annotated by humans with a similarity score across different semantic dimensions (e.g., the main action, subjects, objects, location, and the order of actions). Following Liberatori et al. (2025) , we compute cosine similarity between videos in the embedding space of different encoders and measure alignment using Spearman’s ρ \rho and Kendall’s τ \tau rank correlation coefficients, evaluating how well a model’s latent representations align with human judgment across fine-grained semantic dimensions.

这个基准提出了一套视频对子的数据集,意在衡量基于概念的视频相似性.

blocks.en:
Learned masks improve human similarity alignment. As shown in Table 1 , applying our learned masks yields a consistent improvement in human alignment across the evaluated models. For instance, with V-JEPA 2.1-L, both the discrete binary mask and the continuous soft mask strictly outperform the unmasked baseline across all five conceptual categories. We observe notable increases in the ρ \rho correlation for "Main Subjects" (+6.0 for the binary mask, +6.1 for the soft mask) and "Main Objects", with the soft mask achieving the best overall performance. A similar trend of uniform improvement across all categories is evident for VideoMAEv2-B, where binary and soft mask perform similarly. These results indicate that our training objective successfully forces the models to prioritize features that align with human judgment.
These significant gains in human alignment can be achieved with high feature sparsity when using the binary mask: the V-JEPA 2.1-L and VideoMAEv2-B models achieve superior semantic alignment using only 32.2% and 42.0% of their original embedding dimensions, respectively.
This demonstrates that our learning approach
effectively isolates a concentrated subspace of features that aligns with human perception.
In contrast, unsupervised feature-selection baselines generally do not provide comparable gains. Detailed comparison to various baselines and per-category results are provided in Appendix C.3 .

blocks.en: 4.2 Video generation OOD detection
blocks.zh: 4.2 视频生成OD检测

blocks.en: Transfer to generative OOD detection. We focus on OOD detection for image-to-video generation, where a single input image is used as context to generate future frames. When this context image lies far from the distribution expected by the generative model, the generated video may become unreliable, unstable, or semantically inconsistent. Detecting such OOD inputs is therefore important for estimating when future-frame generation can be trusted. Since OOD detection for generative models often relies on measuring similarity between multiple generated outputs, this experiment tests whether a mask learned from synthetic text-to-video uncertainty can also improve similarity-based uncertainty estimation in another generative task.
blocks.zh: 转入基因OD检测. 我们侧重于图像到视频生成的OOD检测,其中单个输入图像作为上下文生成未来帧. 当这种上下文图像与基因模型所预期的分布相距甚远时,生成的视频可能会变得不可靠,不稳定,或者在分解上不一致. 因此,检测这些OD投入对于估计何时可以相信未来框架的生成十分重要。 由于基因模型的OOD检测往往依赖于测量多个生成输出之间的相似性,因此这个实验测试从合成文本到视频的不确定性中吸取的面具是否能够在另一个基因任务中改善基于相似性的不确定性估计.

blocks.en:
Evaluation setup. We employ NVIDIA Cosmos-Predict2 ( NVIDIA, 2025 ) as our base Image-to-Video (I2V) generative model. To establish a controlled ID baseline, we perform fine-tuning on the BDD100k dataset ( Yu et al., 2020 ) ; consequently, videos from the BDD100k validation set are treated as ID samples. For OOD evaluation, we select four diverse datasets: UVEB (underwater footage) ( Xie et al., 2024 ) , MedVidBench (medical surgery) ( Su et al., 2026 ) , HAM10000 (dermatoscopic images) ( Tschandl et al., 2018 ) , and WikiArt (artistic images) 1 1 1 https://huggingface.co/datasets/huggan/wikiart . While the exact training corpus of Cosmos is proprietary, its design focus on real-world physics and robotics provides high confidence that these four datasets represent significant distributional shifts.
To quantify OOD scores, we adopt two procedures inspired by Franchi et al. (2025) : • 2XDM ( Berry et al., 2024 ; Franchi et al., 2025 ) : We generate two distinct videos from the same context image using different initial random noise. Then, both videos are mapped to an embedding space via a video encoder, and the cosine dissimilarity between their embeddings serves as the OOD score. • DDPM-OOD ( Graham et al., 2023 ; Franchi et al., 2025 ) : We first generate a base video v 0 v_{0} conditioned on a context image using K = 35 K=35 diffusion steps. We then apply k ∈ [ 1 , K ) k\in[1,K) steps of the forward diffusion process to this video and repeat the denoising steps. This procedure is performed three times with k ∈ { 10 , 20 , 30 } k\in\{10,20,30\} to generate three new videos, denoted as v 1 v_{1} , v 2 v_{2} , and v 3 v_{3} , respectively. The final score is computed as the average of the cosine dissimilarities between v 0 v_{0} and each of the three generated videos ( v 1 v_{1} , v 2 v_{2} , v 3 v_{3} ) in the embedding space.

blocks.en: Measuring semantic similarity between high-dimensional video embeddings is fundamental for video retrieval. We focus on UCF101 ( Soomro et al., 2012 ) and HMDB51 ( Kuehne et al., 2011 ) , where given a query video, the objective is to retrieve videos belonging to the same class as the query, thus showing high semantic similarity. We thus benchmark our masked features on both datasets using both V-JEPA 2.1 and VideoMAEv2 feature spaces.

blocks.en: 4.4 Ablations
blocks.zh: 4.4 拖欠款项

blocks.en: To validate the design choices of our proposed feature masking approach, we conduct extensive ablation studies. We aim to answer three primary questions: (Q1) Is our generative consistency objective necessary, or would a standard similarity-based objective suffice? (Q2) Given the high sparsity of our learned masks, is the performance gain simply a byproduct of dimensionality reduction, or are we identifying a highly specific subset of features? And (Q3) Do our highly sparse masks destroy essential visual and structural information?

The necessity of generative consistency (Q1). A naive alternative for learning the feature mask is to optimize for a standard similarity objective. Under this setup, we follow the same training strategy but fundamentally change the definition of positive (similar) and negative (dissimilar) pairs to learn our mask.
In particular, we ignore the idea behind general and specialized concepts and label a pair of videos as semantically similar ( y = 1 y=1 ) if generated from the same prompt and build negative pairs ( y = 0 y=0 ) using videos that come from different prompts. Once again, given that we have generated our dataset with a T2V model, there is no need for manual labeling.

Learned masks vs dimensionality reduction (Q2). Our learned binary masks exhibit high sparsity. For instance, with V-JEPA 2.1-L, the mask zeros out 67.8% of the features using a threshold θ = 0.5 \theta=0.5 , effectively utilizing only 329 329 of the original 1024 1024 embedding dimensions. Similar patterns emerge for VideoMAEv2 (58.0% sparsity). To ensure this improvement is not an artifact of simply reducing the feature space, we compare our method against several dimensionality reduction and feature selection baselines, including random masking, variance-based feature selection, PCA-based methods, Laplacian Score, correlation-based filtering, and a self-attention-derived mask, which we further describe in the Appendix C.2 .
The results in the second half of Tab. 4 validate our approach.
Across both models and OOD methods, none of the other unsupervised feature selection or dimensionality reduction techniques perform as well as the subspace identified by our learning strategy.
This indicates that the features most critical for similarity are not trivial to define.
Notably, our method drastically reduces the False Positive Rate (FPR@95). For instance, in the V-JEPA DDPM-OOD setup, our method reduces the FPR@95 from the unmasked baseline of 70.90% down to 45.60%.

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en:
In this paper, we introduced a self-supervised framework for learning semantic video similarity by leveraging generative uncertainty in text-to-video diffusion models. Rather than relying on human similarity annotations or predefined similarity metrics, our approach uses the consistency of generated videos as a supervisory signal: general concepts tend to produce stable generations, while specialized concepts induce higher generative divergence. We exploit this behavior to learn sparse masks over pretrained video representations, isolating feature subspaces that better capture semantic similarity. Across multiple backbones and tasks, the learned masked representations consistently improve alignment with human similarity judgments, enhance out-of-distribution detection for generated videos, and maintain or improve video retrieval performance. Importantly, these gains are achieved while discarding a large fraction of the original embedding dimensions, leading to more compact and efficient representations. Our dense-task experiments further show that the learned global masks preserve meaningful local structure, enabling efficient patch-level matching with minimal loss in segmentation quality.
Finally, we reproduce the experiments across three different text-to-video models, validating our results on independent sets of videos.
These results suggest that generative models can provide more than synthetic data: their uncertainty can serve as a useful signal for learning semantically useful subspaces.
blocks.zh:
在本文中,我们通过利用文本到视频传播模型中的基因不确定性,引入了学习语义视频相似性的自我监督框架. 我们的方法不是依靠人类相似性说明或预先定义的相似性衡量标准,而是把生成的视频的一致性作为监督信号:一般概念往往产生稳定的世代,而专门的概念则诱导更高的基因差异. 我们利用这个行为 来学习稀疏的面具 而不是经过预先训练的视频表达, 隔离特征子空间 更好地捕捉语义相似性。 在整个多个骨干和任务中,学习的蒙面表现不断改进与人类相似性判断的一致性,加强对生成的视频的传播外检测,并保持或改进视频检索性能. 重要的是,取得这些成就的同时,却抛弃了最初嵌入的很大一部分层面,导致更紧凑和更有效的表述。 我们的密集任务实验进一步表明,所学的全球口罩保留了有意义的局部结构,使得能够有效地进行补丁级匹配,并尽量减少分区质量的损失。
最后,我们通过三种不同的文字到视频模型复制实验,验证我们在独立视频集上的结果。
这些结果表明,基因模型能够提供比合成数据更多的数据:它们的不确定性可以作为学习精密有用的子空间的有用信号.

blocks.en: We ensure that the specialized prompts differ from the general prompts strictly in their semantic domain, rather than through superficial linguistic artifacts (e.g., varying sequence lengths, different grammatical structures, or stylistic shifts). To achieve this controlled domain shift, we leveraged Google’s Gemini 3.1 Pro to generate a parallel dataset of 100 specialized concepts.
blocks.zh: 我们保证专门提示与一般提示在语义领域严格不同,而不是通过肤浅的语言文物(如序列长度不同,语法结构不同,或语法变化). 为了实现这个可控域转移,我们利用Google的双子座3.1 Pro生成了100个专门概念的并行数据集.

blocks.en: We explicitly constrained the language model to synthesize prompts focused on highly specialized, non-everyday domains (specifically, clinical surgery and cellular microscopy) while perfectly mirroring the structural distribution of the general prompts. The exact prompt provided to the language model was as follows:
blocks.zh: 我们明确限制语言模型合成以高度专业化、非日常领域为重点的提示(具体来说,临床手术和细胞显微镜),同时完全反映一般提示的结构分布。 向语言模型提供的准确提示如下:

blocks.en: “I have a dataset of 100 general concept prompts. I need an equivalent set of 100 specialized concept prompts that perfectly match the general dataset in detail, tone, exact length distribution, and concise structural style. The specialized prompts must focus exclusively on the domains of clinical surgery (50 prompts) and cellular microscopy (50 prompts). Additionally, they must be entirely devoid of everyday objects, animals, and human subjects (e.g., ’scissors’, ’dog’, ’person’).” ‘general_prompts.txt’ attached
blocks.zh: “我有100个一般概念提示的数据集。 我需要一套等效的100个专门概念提示,在细节,语气,准确长度分布,以及简洁的结构风格上完全匹配一般数据集. 专门提示必须专注临床手术(50个提示)和细胞显微镜(50个提示)领域. 此外,它们必须完全没有日常物品、动物和人类主体(例如 " 剪刀 " 、 " 狗 " 、 " 人 " )。

blocks.en: By enforcing these constraints, we reduce the likelihood that the observed generative divergence is driven by superficial linguistic differences between the general and specialized prompts.
blocks.zh: 通过执行这些限制,我们减少了观察到的基因差异由一般和专门诱因之间的表面语言差异驱动的可能性。

blocks.en: B.2 Learnable mask training
blocks.zh: B.2 可学习的面具培训

blocks.en:
We optimize the continuous soft mask by partitioning our synthetic dataset of general and specialized video pairs into training (80%) and validation (20%) sets. The mask parameters are updated using the AdamW optimizer with a learning rate of 1 × 10 − 3 1\times 10^{-3} and a batch size of 128. To prevent overfitting, we employ an early stopping mechanism on the validation set. Features from the used video encoder were extracted and stored before training to speed up the process.
Given that we use y = 1 y=1 for positive pairs and y = 0 y=0 for negative pairs, during training the computed cosine similarity is rescaled from [ − 1 , 1 ] [-1,1] to [ 0 , 1 ] [0,1] range to match the target y y .
All training procedures were executed on a single NVIDIA H100 GPU, with an average training time of approximately 1 minute.

blocks.en: B.3 Cosmos-Predict2 finetuning
blocks.zh: B.3 宇宙-预测2微调

blocks.en:
To ensure that driving scenarios from the BDD100k dataset could indeed be considered as In-Distribution (ID) for the Cosmos model, we performed a short fine-tuning.
For our experiments, we used cosmos-predict2 2B model, and fine-tuned it on BDD100k with batch size 32 and learning rate 1.1 × 10 − 6 1.1\times 10^{-6} for 5000 iterations, approximately 12 hours using 16 NVIDIA H100 GPUs.
The resulting model was then used to perform all the image-to-video generation needed for the experiment as described in sec. 4.2 .

blocks.en:

results in useful feature masks when the source generator used to construct
the synthetic training set is changed.

To this end, we independently train masks using the synthetic datasets

blocks.en:
While our mask is optimized using global representations, we evaluate its transferability to dense, patch-level tasks where similarity is computed at a finer granularity. Following Mur-Labadia et al. (2026) , we assess performance on Video Object Segmentation (VOS) using the DAVIS-2017 dataset ( Pont-Tuset et al., 2017 ) . In this task, an initial ground-truth object mask must be propagated across subsequent frames.
We adopt the non-parametric label propagation approach detailed in Mur-Labadia et al. (2026) , which matches local patch features between frames via cosine similarity in the V-JEPA 2.1 embedding space. To ensure a fair comparison, we maintain the hyperparameters reported in the original study.

blocks.en: C.7 Broader impacts
blocks.zh: C.7 更广泛的影响

blocks.en:
This research work proposes a lightweight model-agnostic method to learn a semantic similarity score on top of pretrained feature encoders. Such similarity shows improvements in alignment with human judgment and, as shown with experiments over various tasks, can be used for a variety of real-world use cases that rely on the concept of similarity between two videos.
Additionally, it achieves such results with higher efficiency than baseline methods by effectively reducing the representation dimensions, and thus the storage required by the extracted features.
Negative impacts could result from the limitations and biases inherited from the models used for data synthesis and feature encoding.
blocks.zh:
这一研究工作提出了一种轻量级模型-不可知论方法,在预训特征编码器之上学习语义相似度分数. 这种相似性表明在与人类判断保持一致方面有所改进,并且如关于各种任务的实验所示,可用于依赖两个视频相似性概念的各种现实世界使用案例.
此外,它通过有效减少表达层面,从而减少抽取的特征所需的储存,以比基线方法更高的效率实现这些结果。
负面影响可能来自数据合成和特征编码所用模型的局限性和偏见。

blocks.en: Appendix D Limitations
blocks.zh: 附录D 限制

blocks.en:
While our framework demonstrates the utility of generative uncertainty for representation adaptation, several limitations remain.
First, our pipeline is inherently coupled with the performance and inductive biases of the underlying pre-trained components, including Gemini for prompt synthesis, video generative models for video generation, and the foundation models used as encoders. Any systematic biases or domain-specific shortcomings in these models, such as cultural biases in text-to-video synthesis, may propagate into the learned similarity masks.
Second, our optimization objective prioritizes global semantic consistency. While this yields highly compact and efficient representations, we observed a marginal performance trade-off in tasks requiring dense, fine-grained local precision (e.g., video object segmentation). Future work could explore multi-scale masking strategies to better bridge this gap.
blocks.zh:
虽然我们的框架表明基因不确定性对代表性适应的效用,但仍存在一些局限性。
首先,我们的管道内在结合了基础的预训组件的性能和诱导偏差,包括用于快速合成的双子座,用于视频生成的视频基因模型,以及用作编码器的基础模型. 这些模型中的任何系统性偏见或特定领域缺陷,如文本到视频合成中的文化偏见,都可能传播到所学到的相似性面具中。
第二,我们的优化目标优先考虑全球语义一致性。 虽然这产生了高度紧凑和高效的表述,但我们看到,在需要密集、精细的局部精确度(例如视频物体分化)的任务中,业绩权衡不大。 今后的工作可以探讨多种规模的掩盖战略,以更好地弥合这一差距。
